subject.title: Skill-draft semantic dedup: duplicate drafts with different hash suffixes

question: What should Skill Research treat as the same auto-captured draft before writing a new Skill Workshop proposal?
rationale: The choice affects persisted proposal metadata, replay behavior, duplicate counters, and whether the system uses deterministic provenance or model/provider-dependent semantic similarity.

options.title: Use provenance plus upsert
options.body: Track current-turn signal fingerprints/provenance, revise only auto-capture-owned pending proposals per skill, suppress same-run /learn duplicates, and prevent replay after apply or reject.

options.title: Use semantic similarity counters
options.body: Add embedding or similarity-based coalescing only after maintainers accept threshold, provider, storage, and duplicate-count semantics.

options.title: Keep exact-key behavior
options.body: Leave current exact skillKey suppression plus manual reject/quarantine workflows, accepting some duplicate draft noise.

recommendation.title: Use provenance plus upsert
recommendation.body: Track current-turn signal fingerprints/provenance, revise only auto-capture-owned pending proposals per skill, suppress same-run /learn duplicates, and prevent replay after apply or reject.

likelyOwner.reason: He posted the concrete capture-invariant direction on the active adjacent PR and owns adjacent Skill Workshop command direction in recent merged work.
